description: Search ICD-10-PCS inpatient procedure codes by keyword or code prefix (keyless, offline: CMS FY2026 order file, 79115 billable codes). Diagnoses are search_icd10; PCS is what a hospital bills the procedure itself under. E.g. "hip replacement" -> [{code:"0SR9019", description:"Replacement of Right Hip Joint with Metal Synthetic Substitute, Cemented, Open Approach"}]; "0SR9" returns that whole family.

query.description: Procedure keywords (all words must appear), or an ICD-10-PCS code prefix like "0SR9".

name: search_icd10pcs
title: Search Icd10pcs
